name: dsh-harness-workbench
description: Multi-Harness Workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web: auto-discover local dsh web instances (ports 3080-3129), register remote harnesses, probe status, open/start/stop them, AND read conversation history from other devices (token-gated) so old sessions never have to restart. DSH 多 Harness 工作台：一个面板管理本机与多台远程 Harness，并可跨设备读取原有对话记录。
